scope: Live recheck for a rights-cleared, synchronized public station-to-vehicle fueling holdout

eligibility_rule.required_rights: explicit public reuse or written permission for derived metrics and journal publication

candidates.title: Four years of operational data for five hydrogen refueling stations
candidates.finding: The paper reports operator logbooks with event-level amount, duration, average flow and daily profiles for 350 bar buses. The public record exposes summary figures/tables rather than a synchronized station-controller-vehicle raw time series and does not state reuse terms for raw logs.
candidates.reuse_status: Use for face-validity and workload distributions only; request the de-identified log export and written reuse terms before numerical scoring.

candidates.title: Development, application and optimization of hydrogen refueling processes for railway vehicles
candidates.finding: The open article states that station and vehicle measurements were compared with a model and shows pressure, temperature and mass-flow traces. The repository exposes the article PDF but no machine-readable synchronized logger archive or raw-data reuse terms.
candidates.reuse_status: Use as independent face-validity and data-request lead. Do not digitize figures into the primary holdout without written reuse permission and a predeclared digitization protocol.

candidates.title: FCH2RAIL D6.1 report on KPI assessment
candidates.finding: The public deliverable reports repeated prototype refueling tests and average flow-rate ranges. It does not provide the synchronized source/vehicle raw logger rows required for an untouched numerical holdout.
candidates.reuse_status: Use for bounded operating-range comparison and request provenance only.

candidates.title: H2-Stations export API v2
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 for the published HRS dataset; live API token required
candidates.finding: The API exposes station layout, availability, usage, storage and pricing signals. It does not expose synchronized vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow traces for individual fueling events.
candidates.reuse_status: May support station inventory, availability and demand context after token/licence review; it cannot close the numerical full-loop gate.

candidates.title: IPCEI Hydrogen HRS inventory datastream
candidates.finding: The downloadable workbook describes station location and dispenser type. It contains no fueling-event pressure, temperature or transferred-mass time series.

candidates.title: Group B -- HySam system measurement data
candidates.finding: The open Zenodo record publishes three XLSX workbooks with 0.5 s time columns and pressure, temperature and flow/mass-like tags. The quarantined files match the published byte counts and MD5 hashes. Public metadata and the inspected headers do not provide a channel dictionary, vehicle/receptacle mapping, protocol state, or quality/calibration fields, so the files cannot establish a synchronized station-to-vehicle fueling loop.
candidates.reuse_status: Use as openly licensed HRS sampling-system instrumentation and timing context. Keep it separate from calibration and full-loop scoring until a custodian supplies channel semantics, vehicle/receptacle mapping, protocol metadata and a frozen auxiliary protocol.

candidates.title: Hydrogen station in situ back-to-back fueling data for design and modeling
candidates.finding: The open article describes field operation and back-to-back fueling behavior at the Cal State LA research facility, but the public record exposes aggregate/event summaries and plotted results rather than a rights-cleared synchronized station-to-vehicle row archive.
candidates.reuse_status: Use for scenario and workload context; request the de-identified logger export and written reuse terms before numerical scoring.

candidates.title: Existing Light-Duty Hydrogen Refueling Stations In-Use Study
candidates.finding: The public report covers in-use tests at 22 stations and reports protocol adherence and operating observations, but no reusable synchronized vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow archive is attached.
candidates.reuse_status: Use for independent field face-validity and protocol context; request raw test matrices and reuse permission for numerical validation.

candidates.title: NREL Hydrogen Station Retail Composite Data Products
candidates.finding: The public products report quarterly/daily station dispensing, availability and component-reliability aggregates; they do not provide per-fill synchronized vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow traces.
candidates.reuse_status: Use for station-demand and availability context only; it cannot close the numerical full-loop gate.

next_action: Request a de-identified synchronized logger export and written reuse terms from the FCH2RAIL, Cal State LA HRFF, NREL/NLR HITRF, CARB/HyStEP or HRS custodians; freeze the model and scoring protocol before numerical outcomes are accessed.
claim_boundary: This record documents a current public-data search and exclusion decision. It does not add numerical validation evidence or permit a full-loop readiness claim.
